Chapter 4
System Design and Architecture
4.1
Introduction
The Intelligent Research Assistant is designed using a modular and scalable architecture.
Each module performs a specific responsibility while interacting with other components
through well-defined interfaces. This modular design improves maintainability, scalabil-
ity, and future extensibility.
The system integrates secure authentication, workspace management, document pro-
cessing, semantic search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and citation genera-
tion into a unified platform.
